'''D'Trel B'Rar Jok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]], native to [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]], who was the [[Rel'Kan]] of her people. Although she was little more than a figurehead, she used all of her available power to help the Gorothites during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
